observed_failure_modes: Non-hospitalization observation maps (H or I+H) underperform for this hospitalization-rate target, suggesting a mismatch between latent state and measured series.
SEIR (no waning immunity) with longer delay (3 weeks) performs poorly, indicating the series likely benefits from reinfection/waning dynamics and/or shorter reporting-to-hospitalization lag.

Non-fractional SEIRS with a longer delay (2 weeks) shows worse rolling performance and higher variability across splits than the fractional SEIRS with 1-week delay, suggesting sensitivity to lag choice and reduced robustness without fractional dynamics.
